import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.feature_selection import f_classif

MAX_DRIVERS = 4

def design(feats):
    # Check if any feature shows strong association with outcome
    p_values = []
    for fid in feats.ids:
        col_idx = feats.column(fid)
        x = feats.x[:, col_idx]
        stat, p = f_classif(x.reshape(-1, 1), feats.y)
        p_values.append(p[0])
    
    # If no significant associations, return empty design
    if all(p > 0.05 for p in p_values):
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Find features with p < 0.05
    significant_features = [fid for fid, p in zip(feats.ids, p_values) if p < 0.05]
    
    # Look for correlated pairs with |r| >= 0.6
    correlated_pairs = set()
    for i, fid1 in enumerate(feats.ids):
        for j, fid2 in enumerate(feats.ids[i+1:], i+1):
            if abs(np.corrcoef(feats.x[:, i], feats.x[:, j])[0,1]) >= 0.6:
                correlated_pairs.add((min(fid1, fid2), max(fid1, fid2)))
    
    # Remove near-duplicates (keep one from each pair)
    to_remove = set()
    for a, b in correlated_pairs:
        to_remove.add(b)  # Remove the second in each pair
    
    # Select features excluding near-duplicates
    selected_features = [f for f in significant_features if f not in to_remove]
    
    # Sort by p-value (most significant first)
    selected_features.sort(key=lambda fid: p_values[feats.ids.index(fid)])
    
    # Choose top features as drivers (at most MAX_DRIVERS)
    drivers = tuple(selected_features[:MAX_DRIVERS])
    
    # For columns, include all significant features
    columns = tuple(selected_features)
    
    # For products, consider interactions between highly correlated pairs
    products = []
    for a, b in correlated_pairs:
        if a in selected_features and b in selected_features:
            products.append((a, b))
    
    # Loadings: weight features by their effect size (mean difference)
    loadings = {}
    for fid in columns:
        col_idx = feats.column(fid)
        x = feats.x[:, col_idx]
        mean_y0 = np.mean(x[feats.y == 0])
        mean_y1 = np.mean(x[feats.y == 1])
        loadings[fid] = mean_y1 - mean_y0
    
    return Design(drivers=drivers, columns=columns, products=tuple(products), loadings=loadings)
